result.summary: The parser hardening lacks recovery for transcripts already quarantined by the defect it fixes.

findings.title: Provide a bounded retry for existing parse-threw quarantines
findings.body: The spec preserves ledger behavior without providing an upgrade recovery path. `ledger.selectState()` skips unchanged quarantined files, and `collectExtracts()` applies that decision before parsing. I applied the four proposed filters in memory: the poisoned-text fixture then parsed successfully, but its pre-upgrade quarantine still returned `skip-quarantined`. Consequently, completed sessions affected before the upgrade remain excluded indefinitely unless their files change; the hardened parser never sees them.
findings.recommendation: Specify a bounded recovery mechanism, such as a one-time retry of existing parse-threw quarantines for this parser revision, and expand the deliverables or require a companion migration. Add an upgrade test starting with an unchanged quarantined transcript; preserve unrelated quarantine reasons and re-quarantine inputs that still fail.

next_steps: Define and test recovery from pre-upgrade parse-threw records before dispatching the parser work package.
